program: APPUI-01 - Detailed functional studies inside frozen Phase-1 architecture
question: Can settings, portable Production handling, provider configuration, diagnostics and recovery utilities be coherently reachable without becoming permanent creative navigation or freezing Product-dependent commands?
inherited_law: Utilities live at application or Production scope outside the theatrical Stage.
Ordinary creative work remains current-situation-first; infrastructure stays secondary.
Navigation into a utility surface does not itself mutate Production or provider state.
Provider machinery remains distinct from Character identity and Performer assignment.
Diagnostics and recovery remain truthful infrastructure rather than fiction.
Portable format, provider/cost policy and exact commands remain Product/Phase-D dependent.

design_result.route_role: Deliberate secondary application/Production scope; never a permanent creative home equal to Home/Shaping/current situation.
design_result.navigation_rule: Opening/selecting/closing a utility surface is navigation only until Product authority defines an effective mutation boundary.
state_grammar: provider/capability unavailable != Character refusal or fictional failure
design_result.origin_rule: Current Production/Scene/task and focus-return target remain retained; Close/Back returns to that origin when still valid.
design_result.theme_parity: PASS - Light/Dark preserve one hierarchy and non-authority boundary
design_result.responsive_rule: wide utility task + retained origin context -> medium overlay/substitution -> narrow sequential surfaces; authority state and return remain invariant

mechanical_preflight.environment: Microsoft Edge Chromium CDP; exact self-contained HTML; no external resources

non_authority: Exact utility labels, menu placement, dialogs, commands and confirmation behavior remain provisional.
Exact portable Production format, merge/overwrite rules, compatibility behavior and destinations remain Product-defined.
Exact provider/model/cost policy, authentication, assignment and availability behavior remain Product-defined.
Exact diagnostic, repair, fallback, recovery and destructive-action semantics remain Product-defined.
Final typography, palette, materials, icons, motion and native WinUI behavior remain open.
No Stage visual successor, runtime/package/Store authority or native accessibility-device proof is created.
approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION - CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT
next: Detail the Character-bounded workspace inside the frozen shell, preserving the same Production and persistent Character identity while materially changing disclosure, removing creator-only information and restoring the exact prior creator context on return.
